answer: Each agent identity is registered in knoll, a Merkle state tree, and anchored by karst, a consensus contract; canyon is a ZK attestation circuit validating TPM/SGX measurements and a VDF-bound nonce. Forging identities requires compromising distinct enclaves and recomputing the VDF sequentially; admission uses an O(N^2) bonding curve, while failed proofs irreversibly slash collateral.
